description: This file defines a React component 'Walkthrough' for displaying onboarding or tutorial steps in the Notesnook mobile app, including state management and presentation logic.

classes.name: Walkthrough
classes.description: A React component for displaying a sequence of tutorial steps with navigation and skip options.

methods.name: Walkthrough.update
methods.description: Updates the walkthrough state to mark a specific tutorial as completed and persists it.

methods.name: Walkthrough.init
methods.description: Initializes the walkthrough state from persistent storage.

methods.name: Walkthrough.present
methods.description: Presents the walkthrough component for a given tutorial ID, with optional skip and persistence controls.
